approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: An adorable gentle cartoon animation, widescreen 16:9. A little orange robot with a rounded body, small articulated arms, short legs, and friendly expressive eyes is doing an ordinary household task: carefully watering a small leafy green plant in a terracotta pot. Cozy pastel apartment windowsill, warm morning sunshine, simple clean cartoon shapes, soft shading, charming storybook atmosphere. Static medium-wide camera, one continuous shot, no cuts. The robot stands beside the pot and slowly tips a tiny watering can, sending a delicate stream of water onto the soil; the leaves gently bob, then the robot returns the can upright and looks at the plant with a satisfied smile. Calm deliberate movements across eight seconds. IMPORTANT: From the very first frame through the very last frame, keep the exact text 'Small steps' clearly visible at the top center as a fixed, crisp, easy-to-read title in dark rounded lettering on a light uncluttered upper margin. Title must remain unchanged and stationary throughout, no other text. Keep robot and plant below the title. Entirely silent, no audio, no music, no speech, no sound effects.
